zh-CN.title: 回到顶部动效完善
items: 广场与聊天记录搜索的回顶按钮现在会自然淡入和淡出
按钮退出时会同步停止点击与键盘聚焦，避免残留误触

en.title: Polished back-to-top transitions
items: Back-to-top buttons in Square and chat history search now fade in and out smoothly
Buttons stop accepting pointer and keyboard input while leaving to prevent accidental actions
